events.type: Promised Anna Słonecka's dowry on half his estates
events.note: Before the wedding; the regest calls him "son of Wojciech Otha Trąmpczyński".

events.type: Among the heirs of Trąbczyn, as son of Wojciech

events.note: He made Trąbczyn, Nowa Wieś, Łazy and Osiny over to Maciej Debrzyński for 20,000 złp, his wife consenting; most likely a redeemable sale (wyderkaf, the regest's "wyd.").
Alive for the conveyance of 1642; dead when his widow and sons went to law in May 1644.
